user.title: Choose output
user.description: Choose Home Assistant lights or a physical Philips Hue Bridge. Home Assistant lights are used by default for existing installations.

jointspace.title: Philips TV
jointspace.description: Enter the JointSpace HTTPS API credentials.

jointspace_mapping.title: Map Hue channel
jointspace_mapping.description: {name} (channel {channel_id}, Hue position {position}): choose its TV-relative location.

hue_host.title: Philips Hue Bridge
hue_host.description: Enter the local IP address or hostname of your physical Hue Bridge.

hue_bridge.title: Home Assistant Hue Bridge
hue_bridge.description: Choose a Hue Bridge already configured in Home Assistant.

hue_pair.title: Pair Hue Bridge
hue_pair.description: Press the link button on your Hue Bridge, then select Submit. Waiting for Hue Bridge authorization.

hue_area.title: Entertainment Area
hue_area.description: Choose the physical Entertainment Area to expose to your TV.

pre_pairing.title: Ready to pair
pre_pairing.description:
The next step will start a 60-second pairing window.

Before pressing **Next**, open your TV's settings and navigate to **Ambilight > Ambilight+hue** so it's ready to search for the bridge.

pairing.title: Pairing in progress
pairing.description: Searching for your TV. The pairing window is open for 60 seconds.

not_paired.title: Pairing timed out
not_paired.description: Your TV did not pair within 60 seconds. The bridge will start without a paired TV — you can pair later from the integration's Configure menu.

hue_options.title: Philips Hue Bridge
hue_options.description: Change the physical Hue Bridge or Entertainment Area.

progress.waiting_for_tv: Waiting for your TV to pair…

abort.already_configured: Hue Entertainment Bridge is already configured.
abort.port_in_use: Port 80 is already in use on the Home Assistant host, so the bridge cannot start. See the README for port-conflict options, then try again.

error.hue_pairing_failed: Hue Bridge pairing failed. Check that its link button was pressed.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Philips TV.
error.invalid_auth: TV username or password was rejected.
error.timeout: The Philips TV did not respond in time.
error.tls_error: The Philips TV TLS certificate could not be verified.
error.invalid_topology: The Philips TV returned an invalid Ambilight topology.
error.unknown: The connection or authorization failed. Try again.
error.link_button_not_pressed: Press the Hue Bridge link button, then try again.
error.registration_rejected: Hue Bridge registration was rejected. Try the link button again.
error.malformed_registration_response: Hue Bridge returned an invalid registration response.
error.invalid_generated_credentials: Hue Bridge rejected the newly generated credentials.
error.entertainment_api_initialization_failed: Could not initialize the Hue Entertainment API.

init.title: Hue Entertainment Bridge
init.description: Update the entertainment area lights or pair your TV.

data_description.pair_now: Opens a 60-second pairing window after saving.
data_description.bind_ip: Leave blank to use the auto-detected HA host IP. Set to a secondary IP address (e.g. a macvlan interface) to bind the bridge's HTTP and DTLS servers to that address only, freeing port 80 on the primary IP for Traefik or Nginx.
data_description.http_mode: Where the Hue REST API is served. Automatic: uses Home Assistant's own web server when it listens on port 80 without HTTPS (Settings → System → Network, HA 2026.8+), otherwise a standalone server on port 80. Change only if the automatic choice is wrong.

hue_setup_bridge.title: Set up Philips Hue Bridge
hue_setup_bridge.description: Choose an existing Home Assistant Hue Bridge or enter another bridge.

hue_setup_pair.title: Authorize Hue Entertainment
hue_setup_pair.description: Press the physical link button on your Hue Bridge, then select Submit.

pairing.title: Pair your TV
pairing.description: Open Ambilight Sync settings on your TV now. The pairing window is open for 60 seconds.

not_paired.title: Pairing timed out
not_paired.description: Your TV did not pair within 60 seconds. You can try again from Configure.

jointspace_mapping_options.title: Map Hue channel
jointspace_mapping_options.description: {name} (channel {channel_id}, Hue position {position}): choose its TV-relative location.

progress.waiting_for_tv: Waiting for your TV to pair…

error.registration_rejected: Hue Bridge registration was rejected. Try the link button again.
error.malformed_registration_response: Hue Bridge returned an invalid registration response.
error.invalid_generated_credentials: Hue Bridge rejected the newly generated credentials.
